fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-01-01, the complainant reported that a shop near Nallur Nagar Main Street was occupied without a valid agreement and the occupant refused to leave. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-12-22 at roughly 15:35. Elango Balan approached Palakkad North PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000036. Harish Babu (9000000422) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint mentions Tamilarasan Muthu, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000260, in connection with the events. Potentially relevant material referenced includes photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Premises allegedly occupied after the lease period ended.
fields.Keywords: illegal occupation, lease dispute, mobile number, witness, main street, afternoon, suspect, photograph
